fusions.name: Playing Dead
fusions.desc: A sudden snap that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. It has 50% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrong Turn
fusions.desc: Spits 3 clods of mud at once, spread apart. Each deals 3 damage, with a 20% chance to turn its target against its allies for 2.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dangled Bait
fusions.desc: A feint that pulls up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bided Time
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your next strike has 35% more critical chance. Once every 8 seconds. Your strikes also have 30% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been wounded yet.
